positive_snippets: This hotel offers clean, comfortable rooms with decent amenities and good value for money. The staff is friendly and helpful, and its location near New Delhi Railway Station makes it very convenient. Breakfast is tasty with a fair variety, though service can get slow during busy hours. The main downsides are the noisy, crowded surroundings and occasional maintenance or service delays. Overall, it’s a reliable mid-budget choice worth 4 stars.

Rooms are exceptional for the price. Really clean—among the cleanest I’ve seen in this price range in all of India. Bathrooms are huge, and the shower has excellent water pressure. The staff is also very friendly and ready to assist with anything. The breakfast offers a lot of variety; I just had some fruit, but everything else looked fresh and well-prepared. There’s also a coffee machine that makes great coffee.

We was there for 3 nights and couldn’t complain one bit. The staff was kind and useful they helped with booking private taxi for tour around new and old Delhi and at a reasonable price. The room was nice and comfortable and catered to all are needs. Only thing I could complain about is the price of the beer lol. Highly recommend if you are staying in Delhi for a few nights
negative_snippets: Very bad behaviour of the staffs and the manager .
